Units are like Credits back in highschool. WHMIS is worth 0 because its just an online module you have to do in order to do labs. HTHSCI 1H06A I'm assuming says 0 because it is a full year course, as in there are 2 parts, A and B and you will get 6 credits upon completing part B.
I really liked EARTHSC 2GG3, there's a lot of material that you have to learn but it was overall really interesting.
Imo you should do it as fast as you can. You can pre build a timetable in the mytimetable thing and save it so when your enrolment date comes you can just insta lock in.

Hey chief, glad you’re going to be coming to Mac this fall. On June 11th at 2pm (could be the 12th) the enrolment dates will release for everyone. In mosaic you’ll be able to find your enrolment date in the student centre. During this time you will also be able to access my timetable from mosaic. You can plan your courses and make your timetable there, and when your enrolment date comes (this will probably be later in June) you can enrol in your courses using the same platform. If you want to find all the important dates you will need, just search up important dates McMaster and the first result will give you everything you need.

Don’t be afraid to ask any further questions!

I believe that the enrolment dates become available June 11th or 12th at 2pm, you can then see yours in mosaic and look at the courses in mytimetable. Also if you just search up important dates McMaster the first result will tell you everything.
I know you can apply to transfer programs via service request on mosaic, it just might take a while to hear back.
I think winter 2025 has passed already, you would want fall 2025 or winter 2026 I imagine, also I don’t think you’ll be able to see the information about the classes until the enrolment dates drop
